messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High latency + enqueue growth observed on dedicated pool eu-west-1-pool-3. GPU mem 92%+, tail token latency > 2s, auto-scaler error rate increased. Paging oncall.

sam_oncall: on it. looking at console now.

mira_sre: checking autoscaler logs — seeing repeated 'QuotaExceeded: cannot allocate GPUs' errors in the last 6m. scale requests queued.

sam_oncall: can we flip burst for pool-3? what's the safe duration?

jordan_prodeng: we have a pre-approved emergency burst policy (burst-override) for europe pools. I'd suggest 15m to buy time for autoscaler/quotas to reconcile. apply traffic shaping concurrently to limit non-SLA customers.

sophia_support: getting inbound from 2 customers (acme-inc, tinychat) reporting slow responses. CS opened tickets: #1234 and #1235.

sam_oncall: executing canary: enable burst on pool-3 for 10% of routed traffic first. command: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pools/eu-west-1-pool-3/burst \\\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \\\
  -d '{"enable":true,"duration_m":15,"canary_percent":10,"reason":"emergency surge mitigation"}'
```

mira_sre: API returned: {"status":"ok","action":"burst_enabled","pool":"eu-west-1-pool-3","canary":10} — canary applied.

sam_oncall: monitoring error rates + enqueue. enabling rate-limit policy for free-tier to reduce noisy traffic: set per-customer concurrency cap and token rate.

jordan_prodeng: recommended limits: concurrency cap = 2 for free-tier (was 5), token-rate = 500/min for non-SLA customers. keep SLA customers untouched.

sophia_support: informing CS to message affected customers about degraded perf and mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: metric-alert: queue_depth_eu_west_pool_3 decreased 40% since canary at 30s.

mira_sre: autoscaler still retrying allocations, but I manually triggered a scale-up: created 2 nodes (pod-gpu-45, pod-gpu-46) to reduce pressure. cloud API accepted them.

sam_oncall: canary looks stable at 60s. ramping burst to 100% for the pool now.

Command executed:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pools/eu-west-1-pool-3/burst \\\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \\\
  -d '{"enable":true,"duration_m":15,"canary_percent":100,"reason":"ramp after canary pass"}'
```

console: {"status":"ok","action":"burst_enabled","pool":"eu-west-1-pool-3","canary":100}

sam_oncall: applying traffic-shape rule now: lower per-customer concurrency for non-SLA routes, and prioritize SLA routing. snippet: 
```
POST /api/routing/shape HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN
{ "pool":"eu-west-1-pool-3", "rules": [ {"match":"!customer.sla","concurrency":2}, {"match":"customer.sla","priority":1} ] }
```

jordan_prodeng: also toggled fallback-model routing off for this pool to reduce multimodel overhead.

mira_sre: seeing steady decline in tail latency, enqueue dropped to acceptable levels. autoscaler backlog cleared.

sophia_support: CS updated customers: update sent, tickets annotated.

sam_oncall: summary for pager: 1) burst-override enabled (15m), canary then full ramp. 2) manual scale up +2 nodes. 3) non-SLA rate caps applied. 4) fallback-models disabled for pool. 5) CS notified affected customers.

sam_oncall: handing off monitoring to @mira_sre — I'll be offline for 30m. If anything regresses, escalate to @alex_oncall.

mira_sre: taking over. will watch metrics + logs for next 45m. tagging post-incident follow-up: review quota limits with cloud infra, and add automation to detect quota exhaustion earlier.

sam_oncall: thanks team :white_check_mark:

alex_oncall: acknowledged, I'm on standby for escalation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. status: stabilizing. will auto-close alert if queue depth remains < threshold for 20m.
